name: LevelRail Open-Source Self-Hosted PaaS
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 self-hosted PaaS with Git-based application deployments, HTTPS, logs, metrics, backups and rollback; one software edition without license keys, paid feature gates or vendor usage quotas.
watch_out: Requires user-operated Linux servers and Docker; VPS, bandwidth, domains, storage, registries and operational costs are separate. No provider-hosted compute allowance. Software is pre-1.0: single-server setup is the more tested path, while multi-node support remains beta.
